## Module 3: Working With A Dataset on Night Lights

``` bash
Map.setOptions('SATELLITE')
var snazzy = require("users/aazuspan/snazzy:styles");
snazzy.addStyle("https://snazzymaps.com/style/72543/assassins-creed-iv", "Blank");

// lets look at the population dataset
var population = ee.ImageCollection("CIESIN/GPWv411/GPW_Population_Count")
print (population)

// now pull from years we want
var population_2000 = ee.Image("CIESIN/GPWv411/GPW_Population_Count/gpw_v4_population_count_rev11_2000_30_sec")
print (population_2000)
var population_2015 = ee.Image("CIESIN/GPWv411/GPW_Population_Count/gpw_v4_population_count_rev11_2015_30_sec")
print (population_2015)

//create a color ramp and visualise
var popVis = {
  'max': 1000.0,
  'palette': [
    'ffffe7',
    '86a192',
    '509791',
    '307296',
    '2c4484',
    '000066'
  ],
  'min': 0.0
};
//Map.addLayer(population_2000, popVis, 'population_count_2000');
//Map.addLayer(population_2015, popVis, 'population_count_2015');

//now lets work with night light data
// Nightlights
var nl = ee.ImageCollection("NOAA/DMSP-OLS/NIGHTTIME_LIGHTS")
print (nl)

//now we pick the years we want
// get two images for start and end

var nl_2000 = ee.Image('NOAA/DMSP-OLS/NIGHTTIME_LIGHTS/F142000').select(['stable_lights'], ['nightlight']) //select and rename
var nl_2013 = ee.Image('NOAA/DMSP-OLS/NIGHTTIME_LIGHTS/F182013').select(['stable_lights'], ['nightlight']) //2013 as thats the last year data is available for

print ('nightlight 2000 processed', nl_2000)
print ('nightlight 2013 processed', nl_2013)

var nighttimeLightsVis = {
  'max': 63.0,
  'palette': [
    '000000', // Black  (0   - No light)
    '220000', // Dark Maroon
    '7A0000', // Dark Red
    'E63900', // Red-Orange
    'FFA500', // Orange
    'FFFF00'  // Yellow (63  - Highest intensity)
  ],
  'min': 1.0
};

//Map.addLayer(nl_2000, nighttimeLightsVis, 'Nighttime Lights 2000');
//Map.addLayer(nl_2013, nighttimeLightsVis, 'Nighttime Lights 2013');

var grid5 = ee.FeatureCollection("users/murrnick/mb5370/worldgrid_5deg") // 5 degree grid
print(grid5)
var grid2 = ee.FeatureCollection("users/murrnick/mb5370/worldgrid_2deg") // 2 degree grid
print(grid2)
var grid1 = ee.FeatureCollection("users/murrnick/mb5370/worldgrid_1deg") // 1 degree grid
print(grid1)

//Map.addLayer (grid1, {color:'green'}, 'grid data')

// Import a coastline
var coast = ee.FeatureCollection('projects/UQ_intertidal/dataMasks/naturalEarthCoastline_v1')
print(coast)
//Map.addLayer(coast, {color:'yellow'}, 'coast')

// spatial filter so that grid gets filtered to coasts
//var grid_coast = grid1.filter(ee.Filter.bounds(coast))
//Map.addLayer (grid_coast, {color:'green'}, 'coastal grids')

// Filter ecoregions to bounds
var minigrid_coast = grid5
.filter(ee.Filter.bounds(coast))
//.filter(ee.Filter.bounds(geometry)); // let's limit it for testing, comment this line in and out to go global
//Map.addLayer(minigrid_coast, {color:'firebrick'}, 'coastal grid subset')

//subtract recent pixel values from historical ones
//first for pop change
var pop_change = population_2015
  .subtract(population_2000)
  .clip(minigrid_coast)
//Map.addLayer (pop_change, {palette:  ['red', 'black', 'lime'], min: -500, max: 500}, 'pop_change', true, 0.9)

//then for nightlights
var nl_change = nl_2013
  .subtract(nl_2000)
  .clip(minigrid_coast)
//Map.addLayer (nl_change, {palette:  ['red', 'black', 'yellow'], min: -50, max: 50}, 'nl_change', true, 0.9)

//compute average change of the two variables
// average change in nightlights per ecoregion
var nl_changePerEcoregion = nl_change.reduceRegions({
  collection: minigrid_coast, 
  reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), 
  scale: 1000, // note computing at a larger scale for speed
});

print (nl_changePerEcoregion.first()) // look at properties of the first one

// average change in population per ecoregion
var pop_changePerEcoregion = pop_change.reduceRegions({
  collection: minigrid_coast, 
  reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), 
  scale: 1000, // note computing at a larger scale for speed
});

print (pop_changePerEcoregion.first()) // look at properties of the first one

// Export the result
// Approx 10-20 minute export for scale = 1000.
// Export the result to asset
Export.table.toAsset({
  collection: pop_changePerEcoregion, //
  description: 'export_pop_toAsset',
  assetId:'pop_changePerEcoregion'
});

Export.table.toAsset({
  collection: nl_changePerEcoregion, //
  description: 'export_nl_toAsset',
  assetId:'nl_changePerEcoregion'
});

// Visualise your data
var pop_result = ee.FeatureCollection("projects/mb5370-module-4-dhevin/assets/pop_changePerEcoregion")
Map.addLayer(pop_result)
print (pop_result.limit(5))
print (pop_result.sort('mean', false).limit(10))
var pop_highestchange = pop_result.sort('mean', false).first()
Map.addLayer(ee.Feature(pop_highestchange) ,{color: 'red'} ,'highest change population') //highest change in pop sighted south of india (value =359.02)

var nl_result = ee.FeatureCollection("projects/mb5370-module-4-dhevin/assets/nl_changePerEcoregion")
Map.addLayer(nl_result)
print (nl_result.limit(5))
print (nl_result.sort('mean', false).limit(10))
var nl_highestchange = nl_result.sort('mean', false).first()
Map.addLayer(ee.Feature(nl_highestchange), {color: 'red'},  'highest change night lights') // highest change in night lights sighted in beijing value is 7.87

// Visualise result

var empty1 = ee.Image().byte() // make an empty image
var palette = ['green','yellow', 'orange', 'red'];
var popChangePerEcoregion = empty1.paint({
  featureCollection: pop_result,
  color:'mean'
})

Map.addLayer(popChangePerEcoregion, {max:360, palette: palette}, 'popChange_result')

var empty2 = ee.Image().byte() // make an empty image
var nlChangePerEcoregion = empty2.paint({
  featureCollection: nl_result,
  color:'mean'
})

Map.addLayer(nlChangePerEcoregion, {max:8, min:0, palette: palette}, 'nlChange_result')
```
